kind: proof that querying Trajectory mutates nothing
claim: Trajectory is read-only by construction, not by discipline.

structuralEvidence.portMethodNaming: Every method on every Trajectory port matches ^(list|read|assess|replay|basis|frontier|observations|journal|associations|proofClaimView|projectScopedAssets).
structuralEvidence.noWriterInPorts: There is no append, settle, publish, admit, revise, promote, write or mutate method anywhere in src/trajectory/**.
structuralEvidence.noStoreInModule: src/trajectory/** opens no database, creates no table and holds no durable state. The projection is a pure function of its inputs.
structuralEvidence.compositionAdapterExposesReadsOnly: src/composition/trajectory.ts maps owner READS into the ports and declares no owner write. It is the only module that names both Trajectory and an owner.
structuralEvidence.noReverseDependency: No owner module imports src/trajectory/**. The architecture checker reports 0 forbidden edges and 0 new cycles.
structuralEvidence.noPackageExport: The public API check reports 0 added names: src/trajectory is an internal capability and is not re-exported from src/index.ts or src/advanced.ts.
structuralEvidence.projectionFlag: Every TrajectoryProjection carries readOnly: true as a literal.

runtimeEvidence.measured: After two buildProjectTrajectory calls, the Work event count and the last event digest are unchanged, and the owner's own EventStore.verifyFull() still passes.
After two projections, the Work event count is unchanged, the proof plane's chainDigest is unchanged, and the reasoning cell view is deeply equal to its pre-query value.

The port method names are asserted against ^(list|read|assess); the module barrel is asserted to export no name matching ^(append|settle|publish|admit|revise|promote|write|mutate); a repeated query leaves the input history's length and digest unchanged.

uncheckedDimensions.reason: The Trajectory projection reads no git repository. It has no git port, so it cannot move a HEAD or a worktree.
The projection reads journal entries and associations through their stores; it never writes asset content, and the stores it reads are append-only with no Trajectory-held handle.
